# 共同活动中的差别制造：多重决定下 but-for 与关系参与分离 / Difference-making in joint activity: but-for and relational participation come apart under overdetermination

## 主张 Claim

在一个依存可观测量的过程中，配置之间的维持与断裂沿运行恰是 Becoming.Dependence 的维持与断裂，两者互斥。but-for 检验留在过程之内，并固定实际所取的动作：由某配置以某动作的一步断裂依存，而扣除某一方的部分后以同一动作的每一步都维持它，则这一方的部分造成了差别；扣除任何单独一方的部分、以同一动作仍有断裂之步，为多重决定，此时没有哪一方单独造成差别。不固定动作时，动作决定结果：由同一配置，唯一汲取者的部分在平静的动作下造成差别，在外来冲击下损失被多重决定。在 Pool 中，同一过程、同一水平，第一个汲取者取同样的量：另有一方汲取时，它的部分造成差别；另有两方汲取时损失被多重决定，它的部分不造成差别，而扣除两方的部分则维持依存，差别由共同活动造成。两次运行中，关系读法都把它计为消耗，一个什么也不取的形成不计为消耗。一个形成的各事件之间须分开整段与步层面的检验：在公地过程中每步汲取两个单位，条件被消耗；第一个事件那一步维持依存，对任何正长度的周期都不侵蚀；扣除任何一个事件的汲取，甚至扣除任何一步之前的全部汲取，条件仍被消耗，整段的结局由尾部决定；而在断裂之步，由同一配置不汲取则依存被维持，断裂事件造成那一次断裂的差别。逐步读法不追踪差别制造：在 Pool 中恰取更新量、其部分不造成差别的汲取者，在另一方造成的断裂之步侵蚀。不用伦理前提，也不用 Lean 公理。 / In a process with observables of dependence, keeping and breaking between configurations are, along a run, exactly those of Becoming.Dependence, and they are exclusive. The but-for test stays within the process and holds the move actually taken fixed: when the step from a configuration by a move breaks a dependence and, with one party's part withheld, every step by the same move keeps it, that party's part makes the difference; when withholding any single party's part still leaves a breaking step by the same move, the loss is overdetermined and no party alone makes the difference. Without the move held fixed, the move decides: from one configuration a lone drawer's part makes the difference under a calm move, while under an exogenous shock the loss is overdetermined. In Pool, in one process at one level with the first drawer taking the same amount: with one other drawer its part makes the difference; with two others the loss is overdetermined and its part makes none, while withholding two parts keeps the dependence, so the difference belongs to the joint activity. In both runs the relational reading counts it as consuming, and a formation that takes nothing is not. Across a formation's own events the run-level and step-level tests come apart: drawing two units at every step in the commons process consumes the condition; the first event's step keeps the dependence and undermines for no positive cycle; with any single event's draw withheld, indeed with every draw before any step withheld, the condition is still consumed, the run-level outcome being fixed by the tail; at the breaking step, drawing nothing from the same configuration keeps the dependence, so the breaking event makes the step-level difference. The stepwise reading does not track difference-making: in Pool a drawer taking exactly the renewal, whose part makes no difference, undermines at the break another causes. No ethical premise and no Lean axiom is used.

Canonical source: [Joint.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Joint.lean)

## 前提与对应 Hypotheses and correspondence

- 扣除（withhold）是外给的配置变换：只改动一方或一步的部分，过程本身给出由此到达的配置。扣除是否让其余不变，是每次应用的建模义务。检验固定实际所取的动作：动作属于其余的活动。在 Pool 中下一步的水平不依赖动作，结论不受影响。 / Withholding is a supplied map on configurations: it changes only one party's or one step's part, and the process gives the configurations reached from there. Whether withholding leaves the rest unchanged is a modelling duty of each application. The test holds the move actually taken fixed: the move belongs to the rest of the activity. In Pool the next level does not depend on the move, so the conclusions are unaffected.
- 关系读法是 relational-reading-comparison 的整段读法，经 Web.ConsumingIn 读出。 / The relational reading is the whole-run reading of relational-reading-comparison, read through Web.ConsumingIn.
- 整段层面的检验（扣除事件的汲取后条件是否仍被消耗）与 MakesDifference（扣除配置之中的部分后这一步是否维持依存）是不同的检验；公地过程中汲取是动作而不是配置的一部分，所以 depletion_is_joint 用的是前者。 / The run-level test (whether the condition is still consumed with events' draws withheld) and MakesDifference (whether the step keeps the dependence with a part of the configuration withheld) are different tests; in the commons process the draw is the move, not part of the configuration, so depletion_is_joint uses the former.

but-for 检验与关系读法回答不同的问题：前者问扣除一方的部分是否改变结果，后者问一方实际参与了什么及该条件的去向。多重决定的情形正是“我的一份无关紧要”这一推理的形式。两者都不是因果理论，也不推出责任或义务。关于集体伤害与过度决定的哲学讨论（如 Parfit、Kagan，作者据先前知识，本次未新读）是对照。“but-for 不能代替参与”只对单一部分的、整段层面的检验证明；步层面的检验挑出断裂事件，NESS 一类检验是另外的对手。 / The but-for test and the relational reading answer different questions: whether withholding a party's part changes the outcome, and what a party actually took part in and where the condition went. The overdetermined case is the form of “my share makes no difference”. Neither is a causal theory, and neither yields responsibility or duty. Philosophical work on collective harm and overdetermination (for example Parfit and Kagan, from the author's prior knowledge, not newly read) is the comparison. That “but-for cannot replace participation” is shown only for the single-part, run-level test; the step-level test picks out the breaking event, and NESS-type tests are further rivals.

- 多重决定（Pool.difference_belongs_to_the_joint 的三方运行）：每一方单独都不造成差别，共同活动造成了损失。在一个形成的各事件之间，整段层面没有哪个有限的事件集合造成差别（Commons.depletion_is_joint、Commons.no_finite_segment_makes_difference），而断裂事件造成步层面的差别（Commons.breaking_event_makes_step_difference；第二次独立审查 F7）。 / Overdetermination (the three-drawer run of Pool.difference_belongs_to_the_joint): no party alone makes the difference, while the joint activity makes the loss.
